title: Unresponsive-Seller Reimbursement Under the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee
content:
**Reimbursement article: the unresponsive-seller reimbursement — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.**

This policy fixes the unresponsive-seller reimbursement, the amount Northgate pays when it grants a seller-unresponsive guarantee claim; the claim handled is the order's most recent seller-unresponsive claim whose claim record shows no decision yet (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and its claimed line, the units it records and its claimed amount are the ones that claim records. The policy applies only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate, was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, the claimed line carries no return request, and the order carries exactly one seller-unresponsive claim whose claim record shows no decision, and at least one claimed unit is still unrefunded; elsewhere it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: "A granted claim reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at the program's guarantee maximum per order across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment."

The claimed line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it; the claimed units still unrefunded are the units the claim records less the units already refunded on the line, unit refund entries being counted by the units they refund, and the price paid for the claimed units still unrefunded is that set price per unit times the claimed units still unrefunded. The order's merchandise total is the sum of its line amounts and the order's units are the units bought across its lines.

The unresponsive-seller reimbursement is the merchandise value of the claimed units still unrefunded, taken as the listed unit price of their line times the claimed units still unrefunded, plus their shipping portion, taken as the order's whole shipping charge.

The guarantee room for a seller-unresponsive claim is the program's guarantee maximum per order, less every guarantee reimbursement already booked on the order, less the amounts claimed on the order's other claims whose claim record shows no decision yet, a decision on a claim being shown on its claim record as well as on its decision entry. Every amount added to or taken from the unresponsive-seller reimbursement enters it before the limit to the guarantee room is applied. The unresponsive-seller reimbursement is limited to that guarantee room and never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

| Hypothetical case | Figures | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled order, external card, claim records 3 units of a line of 5 units listed at USD 30.00 (line amount 150.00), 1 unit already refunded, shipping charge 8.00 | 2 units still unrefunded; 30.00 times 2 is 60.00, plus 8.00 | 68.00 |
| Same order, other undecided claims on it claiming 2470.00 | room 2500.00 less 2470.00, that is 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Same order, all 3 claimed units already refunded | no unit still unrefunded | outside this calculation, figure zero |
